look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Find a trailing, rough-hairy vine with curling tendrils, broad heart-shaped to shallowly lobed leaves with toothed edges, and five-lobed yellow flowers. Male flowers may cluster, while female flowers have a small developing melon behind the petals. Fruit form is variable among cultivated melons; use flower, leaf and tendril features together.
